smallest_required_input: A funded provider key with the declared review model, or a readable local Ollama model store.
policy_v1: Approve Open records with Amount >= 100 and Risk Low. Review Open records with Amount 50-99 or Risk High. Deny Closed records. Exception: North region with Risk High requires Review even when Amount >= 100.
policy_v3: Approve Open records with Amount >= 100 regardless of Risk. Review Open records with Amount 50-99. Deny Closed records.
